diagnostics: equal-task/group camera/horizon errors and paired 10000 within-task group bootstrap
RGB mean absolute change bins low<=0.01 medium<=0.05 high>0.05, appearance/camera changes included
optimistic centered output-head span bound on current and future teacher features for absolute models only
cosine and weighted-variance parameter-gradient norms and alignment, including front h2 on fixed fit batch
collapse matched to pilot_eval target group means
core token swap and action/horizon ablations on pilot_eval
future_interface: Both expose the identical 128x256 core future tokens. Measure same-task other-group token swaps plus zero-actions, reversed-actions and zero explicit horizon. Do not equate output-copy gains with useful learned dynamics.
isolation: Entire numeric groups disjoint between fit and pilot_eval. Both remain in the original train split. Production v1 reference saw these groups during its original training; reference results are in-sample, not a fair held-out competitor. Fresh pilot arms never optimize on pilot_eval.
loss_changes: None; gradient conflict is diagnostic, no variance-weight tuning in this run

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: 200-update linear warmup, cosine to 0.1 times lr at fixed endpoint

reference_role: frozen in-sample diagnostic only; no updates
sampling: Identical PCG64(seed) shuffles of 320 fit anchors; batches of 8 anchors, all five horizons (40 pairs), retain full logical variance via microbatch10 exact replay. Repeat the small fit set; pilot exposure is separate from production.
scope: User-requested steps 1 and 2: train-only diagnostic and fresh absolute versus copy-preserving residual pilot; no production or validation/test evaluation
screen_interpretation: GO_FOR_FURTHER_TRAIN_ONLY_VERIFICATION only if all criteria pass after independent audit. Otherwise NO_GO_OR_INCONCLUSIVE. No screen result accepts a checkpoint or authorizes a production run. Single paired seed, sparse small-cohort pilot, no downstream policy-success evidence.
selection_rule: Train numeric groups only; all 40 tasks; SHA256-ranked 2 fit and 2 pilot_eval groups per task; one SHA256-ranked episode per group; 4 anchors at 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 of L-33; all five horizons
treatment: Same 4238592-parameter core and seed; 526336-parameter head. Residual head zero-initialized, raw delta divided by sqrt(2048), added to detached canonical CURRENT teacher features then LN/L2 normalized. Additional current teacher path and different head initialization are declared; not a pure objective-only comparison. Future targets never enter conditioning.
